correctness.rationale: For every k,r>=0, the prefix-balance argument forces each complement remainder to split into 01 or 10 pairs. At every halfway point of a 10 pair the deleted-pattern prefix has an unclosed 0; a separating 01 pair forces it closed, proving distinct 10-runs need distinct deleted 01 pairs. Conversely, replacing each 10-run of length ell by 0(10)^ell 1=(01)^(ell+1) constructs a matching shuffle, with arbitrary extra deleted 01 pairs. Selecting 2j boundaries among r+1 gives exactly binomial(r+1,2j) words with j such runs. Edge cases k=0,r=0 and saturation r<=2k follow. Independent direct deletion enumeration passed 45 cases and shuffle-pointer DP 23,535 cases; bounded tests are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The March 2026 source expressly seeks closed formulas for |C(w,u)| in natural cases. The aligned two-parameter alternating family is a canonical minimal nonunary test bed. The result is a complete infinite two-parameter language-and-count classification, identifies the minimum deleted alternating-pair budget for each output, and establishes a sharp saturation transition r=2k; it is more than a routine isolated count or restatement of a binomial runs identity.
